subject: qplot data.frame with special characters in names

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: qplot data.frame with special characters in names
parts:
Please see the following example, the first qplot works, but the
second doesn't. Should qplot be modified so that the second works as
well?


#############
x=data.frame(1:10,10:1)
names(x)=c('(A)', '(B)')
library(ggplot2)
qplot(x$'(A)', x$'(B)')#this works

qplot('(A)', '(B)', data=x)#this does not work

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: qplot data.frame with special characters in names
parts:
Those look like single quotes and not back ticks. Use single quotes
for strings and backticks for special name.

Hadley
